name: Tango
description: The Tango server gives AI agents access to reliable, LLM-friendly federal procurement competitive intelligence so that procurement professionals can focus on delivering on mission.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tango to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tango to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://govcon.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tango MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tango provides these MCP tools: resolve, search, search_opportunities, and get_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tango?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Tango in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
Tango requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tango is developed by MakeGov Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
